problem_model.system_description: Apprentice is an adaptive model distillation framework that trains cheap local models on expensive frontier APIs automatically, starting by routing requests to frontier APIs (Claude, GPT), collecting outputs as training data, fine-tuning local models, then progressively shifting traffic while continuously verifying quality to replace $15/M-token APIs with $0 local models
stakeholders: developers making recurring domain-specific API calls
users needing quality guarantees and phased rollout

failure_modes.description: Source-watermark risk in v5 with room_count + amenity_count combinations
Backup index grows unbounded without prune policy

failure_modes: Quality correlation drops requiring automatic regression to Phase 2
Budget limits exceeded triggering spend enforcement
PII detection false positives/negatives affecting data quality
Local model validation failures blocking promotion to Phase 3
assumptions: Current broad package/runtime work can be stabilized as v1 baseline
builtin and http tools are safe for direct execution
Package registry metadata persistence improves startup diagnostics
Models are commodities, data is the asset
API calls serve as both results and labeled training examples
Local models can absorb teacher behavior for specific domains
Quality correlation can be measured mechanically
builtin and HTTP tools are safe for direct execution in package runtime
boundaries: 5 matches/week cap for both candidates and jobs in TalentSync
Must validate exactly 10 specific AI crawlers
Do not hard-code Reeve or Wander concepts into generic Apprentice modules
Do not execute high-risk tool kinds (cli, python, mcp) without permission/preflight adapter
Keep private host package content outside the Apprentice repo
Treat current package schema as v1 with migration handling for future changes
For recurring, domain-specific tasks where frontier models are overkill
Not for unique creative requests or open-ended brainstorming
Not for low-volume usage where API costs don't matter
External skill packages should live outside Apprentice repo
cli, python, and mcp tool declarations exposed for host-specific executors only
history: Current SkillPackage support validates and maps events but doesn't invoke methods/tools
success_shape: Production-grade and general-purpose without host application dependencies
Preserve backward compatibility for existing Apprentice and WOS endpoints
Runtime behavior must be inspectable, auditable, and testable without live vendor credentials
28-component modular architecture with 21 zero-dependency leaf components
Three-phase data-driven progression (Cold Start → Reinforcement → Steady State)
Automatic phase transitions based on correlation thresholds

Quality guarantees through measurable correlation scores
Phased rollout with automatic regression capabilities
